## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] New commands or flags are covered by a test and documented in `docs/GUIDE.md`
- [ ] No API keys, customer data or private site content in code, tests or docs
